cc:Work.dc:description: Source: docs/neupims-validation.md. Historical local controlled NeuPIMs ablation: regenerated RR 650229 ns, author CLB 619233 ns, 4.7669% lower modeled latency. Same ordered 512 requests and platform; one layer, one decode token, includes simulator drain. Zero-based latency axis. Raw historical run bundles are not distributed. Task quality and physical hardware performance are unvalidated.
